books.title: Never Letting Go: Heal Grief with Help from the Other Side
books.author: Mark Anthony
books.description: Mark Anthony's book for people mourning a loved one, drawing on his work as a medium. He describes the signs and contact he believes come from those who have died and offers ways of living with loss.

free_resources.title: Grief Management
free_resources.description: A free page on Mark Anthony's site about living through bereavement, with suggestions such as turning to faith and community, meditation and prayer, uplifting activities and grief support groups. It frames grief as something to move through rather than get over.

left_out: Videos 'From Grief to Growth' and 'Helping Parents Heal': videos are handled separately.
